# EigenstateLzToL

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/EigenstateLzToL`

```text
EigenstateLzToL, version 0.01

Usage: EigenstateLzToL [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (0 if it has to be guessed from file name) (default value = 0)
    -l, --lzmax : twice the maximum momentum for a single particle (0 if it has to be guessed from file name) (default value = 0)
    -z, --lz : twice the total lz value of the system (default value = 0)
    -s, --statistics : particle statistics (boson or fermion, try to guess it from file name if not defined)

data options:
    -f, --file-prefix : prefix for all data files (vectors have to be of the form prefix_x.y.vec and Lz spectrum prefix.dat)
    --l-error : error above which a vector is no more considerated as an eigenvector of L^2 (default value = 9.9999999999999998e-13)

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
